title: Sabbath Regulations and Offerings for the Tabernacle

questions.question: What did Moses first remind the people about before collecting offerings?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:2 (ESV): "Six days work shall be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord."

questions.question: What specific activity was forbidden on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:3 (ESV): "You shall kindle no fire in all your dwelling places on the Sabbath day."

questions.question: How did the people respond to the call for offerings?
options: Everyone whose heart stirred him came and brought offerings
questions.correctAnswer: Everyone whose heart stirred him came and brought offerings
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:21 (ESV): "They came, everyone whose heart stirred him, and everyone whose spirit moved him, and brought the Lord's contribution."

questions.question: Who led the tabernacle construction?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:30,34 (ESV): "See, the Lord has called by name Bezalel... He has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab."

questions.question: What materials did the people bring?
options: Gold, silver, bronze, yarn, linen, skins, wood, oil, spices, and onyx stones
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, bronze, yarn, linen, skins, wood, oil, spices, and onyx stones
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:5-9 (ESV): Lists gold, silver, bronze, blue/purple/scarlet yarns, fine linen, goats' hair, tanned rams' skins, goatskins, acacia wood, oil, spices, and onyx stones.

questions.question: What special skill did the women contribute?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:25 (ESV): "Every skillful woman spun with her hands, and they all brought what they had spun."

questions.question: What did the leaders bring specifically?
options: Onyx stones, spices, oil for the light, and for the anointing oil and incense
questions.correctAnswer: Onyx stones, spices, oil for the light, and for the anointing oil and incense
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:27-28 (ESV): "The leaders brought onyx stones... and spices and oil."

questions.question: What motivated the people to give?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:29 (ESV): "All the men and women, the people of Israel, whose heart moved them to bring anything for the work."

questions.question: What abilities did God give Bezalel?
options: To devise artistic designs and work in gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood
questions.correctAnswer: To devise artistic designs and work in gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:32-33 (ESV): "To devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze, in cutting stones... and in carving wood."

questions.question: What additional gift did God give Bezalel and Oholiab?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:34 (ESV): "He has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab."

questions.question: From which tribe was Bezalel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:30 (ESV): "Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah."

questions.question: What was the penalty for working on the Sabbath restated here?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:2 (ESV): "Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death."

questions.question: What did the women spin from goats' hair?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:26 (ESV): "All the women whose hearts stirred them to use their skill spun the goats' hair."

questions.question: Who is Bezalel's grandfather?
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:30 (ESV): "Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur."

questions.question: Both men and women brought what types of jewelry as offerings?
options: Brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets
questions.correctAnswer: Brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets
questions.explanation: Exodus 35:22 (ESV): "They came, both men and women... they brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and armlets."

key_verse_text: And they came, everyone whose heart stirred him, and everyone whose spirit moved him, and brought the Lord's contribution.
